title: Hope
excerpt: Is what I need, is what I had, may it steal for me that which is not sad, people say it has the power of inspiration, that key that fits into the lock of new creation. Hope is what I need, is what I had, come back to me, so that I’m no longer sad!
content:
Is what I need, is what I had,
may it steal for me that which is not sad,
people say it has the power of inspiration,
that key that fits into the lock of new creation.
Hope is what I need, is what I had,
come back to me, so that I’m no longer sad!
